Name: Robin's Farm Cleaner Service
Author: Malacay2k11
Description:
[center][color=#ff7700][size=3]Let Robin do the hard work, so you can focus on what matters.[/size][/color]


[color=#ff0000][size=4][b]What is this mod?[/b][/size][/color]

Tired of spending half your day swinging an axe at tree stumps, picking up branches, and manually harvesting 80 cauliflowers one by one?
Robin Farm Cleaning Option adds a Cleaning Board to the game. Place it on your farm, interact with it, and let Robin handle the dirty work, for a fair price.



[b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Features[/size][/color][/b]

[b]Farm Cleanup Service[/b]
Robin will clear your entire farm of:
- Stones & Boulders
- Trees & Stumps
- Branches & Twigs
- Bushes
- Grass
- Everything is optional!

All removed materials are [b]directly added to your inventory[/b]. Nothing is wasted.
⏳ Cooldown: Once every 21 days, Robin needs time to recover!


[b]Harvest Helper Service[/b]
Don't want to spend an entire morning harvesting?
Robin will collect all [b]ready crops and forage [/b]from your farm and hand them directly to you.
⏳ Cooldown: Once every 7 days

[b]Fence Services
[/b]Robin can repair & upgrade your Fences for a small Loan and Fee.
Upgrade Fences from Wood > Stone > Iron > Hardwood
[/center]
[center]
[b][color=#ff0000][size=3]How to get the Cleaning Board[/size][/color][/b]

Reach [b]1 heart of friendship[/b] with Robin — she'll send you a letter the next morning and the board as a gift one day later.
You can also [b]**buy additional boards**[/b] directly from Robin's carpenter shop (after receiving the mail).


[b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Installation[/size][/color][/b]
1. Install [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/)
2. Drop the `RobinService` folder into your `Mods` directory
3. Launch the game, that's it!
[b]No dependencies required[/b]



[color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Languages[/b][/size][/color]
[b]German · English · Spanish · French · Italian · Japanese · Chinese[/b]


[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]
[color=#ff0000][size=3][b]⚙️ Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
- Stardew Valley **1.6+**
- SMAPI **4.0+**
- Compatible with most other mods
- Multiplayer: works for the **host player**


[b][size=4]Have fun and let Robin handle the rest! ??[/size]

[/b]
[quote][url=https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=JR5N34NUY9TMJ][color=#ff7700]Donate a Cup of Coffee ?![/color][/url][/quote][/center]
